subject: How to use graphics is a filter to change others graphics in a Dashboard

messages.author: 8abb162e5961cd1c
messages.subject: How to use graphics is a filter to change others graphics in a Dashboard
parts: Hello guys, I would like to know how to build graphics (in R with shiny app) that are able to interact with other graphics in a dashboard. Example: I have three graphics and when I click in some data from the graphic number 1, the other graphics will responde showing information about the data called in graphic number 1. If anyone knows how to help me I will be very gratefull.

messages.author: ca3788b72c6f9389
messages.subject: How to use graphics is a filter to change others graphics in a Dashboard
parts:
Hello,

You can add filter on your data for each graphs.
If you are selecting company name then add a filter like this
Graph2_data <- raw_data %>%
filter(Company_name == input$companyname)

Hope this is what you are looking for
